# SSH sessions between this library's client and OpenSSH's sshd,
# recorded on loopback by scripts/check_ssh_client.py --record.
#
# Each session ran with the client's randomness drawn from a
# counter seeded with `seed`, so tests/test_ssh_sessions.rs can
# replay the `S` lines (what sshd sent) at a client seeded the same
# way and require it to produce the `C` lines exactly. The user keys
# exist only for this file. Do not edit: a changed byte is a
# session sshd never had.
#
# sessions: 24
